page_title: GET 2-0 BET | Getafe v Betis 08/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Antony (Betis) for his blatant foul.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' A fine pass finds Cedric Bakambu (Betis) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the David Soria reacts superbly to deny him.
86' Diego Llorente (Betis) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
86' Pablo Fornals (Betis) will deliver the corner kick.

86' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Betis will have a corner.
85' Luis Vazquez will be replaced by Diego Rico (Getafe).
82' Pablo Fornals (Betis) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
80' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
77' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Allan Nyom (Getafe) replacing Kiko Femenia.
75' Here's the change. Cucho Hernandez leaves the pitch and Cedric Bakambu (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
74' Jose Bordalas Jimenez isn't happy on the touchline after referee Francisco Maeso shows him a yellow card.
73' Marc Bartra (Betis) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
73' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
73' A lofted cross from Chimy Avila (Betis) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Betis earn a corner.
72' Chimy Avila (Betis) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
72' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Betis have a corner.
72' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
72' Antony (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Here is a change. Junior Firpo is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Diego Llorente (Betis).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sebastian Boselli (Getafe) comes onto the pitch so that Domingos Duarte can be given a rest.
68' A dangerous towering header by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
67' The ball is out of play. Getafe win a corner kick.
64' A cross by Kiko Femenia (Getafe) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
62' Antony (Betis) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
61' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Nelson Deossa will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis).
61' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Alvaro Fidalgo and he is replaced by Pablo Fornals (Betis).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abde Ezzalzouli leaves the pitch and Antony (Betis) comes on.

60' Angel Ortiz (Betis) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
58' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Domingos Duarte (Getafe) for a tough tackle.

55' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! David Soria dived superbly to block a header by Cucho Hernandez (Betis) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the right post, but David Soria pulled off a remarkable save!

50' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Alvaro Valles pulls off an easy save.
48' The game is interrupted as Luis Vazquez (Getafe) is flagged offside.
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Bordalas Jimenez decided to make a change. Abdel Abqar is replaced by Mario Martin (Getafe).
46' Referee Francisco Maeso blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+7' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
45+7' Luis Milla (Getafe) will take a corner kick.

45+7' Martin Satriano (Getafe) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Getafe will take a corner.
45+4' Nelson Deossa (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but David Soria comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+1' 2 - 0 Goal! Abdel Abqar finds Martin Satriano (Getafe) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 2:0.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
44' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.

44' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Betis are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
41' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
39' Angel Ortiz (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
37' Marc Bartra (Betis) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
36' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
35' Betis take a short corner kick.
35' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for David Soria to dive and make a save.
35' Betis win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
34' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
32' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) heads on.

28' 1 - 0 The goalkeeper makes a save but the ball rebounds off him out to Kiko Femenia (Getafe). He finds himself some space inside the penalty area and unleashes an unstoppable shot which bounces in off the crossbar. A magnificent goal!
28' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Alvaro Valles is prepared and dives to thwart him.
24' Valentin Gomez (Betis) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but David Soria pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
23' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Chimy Avila (Betis), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
23' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' Wonderful movement by Betis. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

18' Nelson Deossa (Betis) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
18' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

16' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Chimy Avila (Betis) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
12' The resulting corner from Luis Milla (Getafe) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
12' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
9' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
7' Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity. Luis Milla (Getafe) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
4' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
2' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Alvaro Fidalgo (Betis) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where David Soria easily catches the ball.
1' The match has just started.
Getafe will kick the game off.
Francisco Maeso will referee today's match.
